def equation(x: np.ndarray, v: np.ndarray, params: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """ Mathematical function for acceleration in a damped nonlinear oscillator

    Args:
        x: A numpy array representing observations of current position.
        v: A numpy array representing observations of velocity.
        params: Array of numeric constants or parameters to be optimized

    Return:
        A numpy array representing acceleration as the result of applying the mathematical function to the inputs.
    """
    """ Improved Version of `equation_v1`.
    
    Args:
        x: A numpy array representing observations of current position obtained up to the loop.
        v: A numpy array representing observations of velocity obtained up to the loop.
        params: Array of numeric constants or parameters to be optimized.
    
    Returns:
        A numpy array representing acceleration as the second derivative of velocity according to the given function.
    """
    
    N = len(v)
    omega = params[1]  # Coefficient of Viscous Drag
    
    # Getting all appropriate derivatives shifting one time step at a time.
    if N>1:
        v_pre = v[:-1]  # Previous Value
        v_next = v[1:]   # Next Value
    else :
        v_pre = None
        v_next = None
    
    a = v_next - omega * (x - v)
    # Precess the velocity for calculations
    v_derivative = v_pre - v
    return a
